question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6737daa6c157fe073725ba296b7647d51da090f71394d889347db3c59185720c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09b19d6269e9f6b4289fe209a6ec3126bcf7f31928496f77a1070c0a8c6b162b.png] 

When the mirror is placed vertically to the objects/ alphabets, then the image will be laterally inverted. In other words, the **Left Hand Side** and the **Right Hand** **Side** will interchange their positions, while top and bottom will remain same.

Therefore, only option (2) shows the correct mirror image.

Hence, the correct answer is** option(2)**
